title: Ticket Media, Collection Points and Media Charges
content:
The days on a Lift Tickets order are carried on media, and the schedule below sets out, for each product in the line, what the days are carried on, what the media costs, whether days may be loaded onto media the guest already holds, what replacing lost or broken media costs, whether the holder must collect the media at a ticket office before their first day, and which of the collective's mountains have ticket offices that issue the product. The media forms the line is written for are a paper ticket, an RFID card and a mobile pass.

| Product | Media | Media charge | Loading onto media already held | Replacement charge | Collection before the first day | Issuing ticket offices |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | paper ticket | USD 0.00 | not allowed | USD 0.00 | required | Granite Ridge |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | RFID card | USD 5.00 | allowed | USD 25.00 | required | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | RFID card | USD 5.00 | allowed | USD 25.00 | not required | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | RFID card | USD 5.00 | allowed | USD 25.00 | not required | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Copper Hollow |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | RFID card | USD 0.00 | allowed | USD 20.00 | not required | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Copper Hollow |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | RFID card | USD 0.00 | allowed | USD 0.00 | not required | Granite Ridge, Hollow Creek, Silverpine Basin, Talon Peak, Copper Hollow |

## Basis questions the schedule answers

**What is the media charge?** It is the one-off charge for the reusable media the days are loaded onto. Three products in the line carry a charge of USD 5.00 and three carry none.

**What is the replacement charge?** It is the charge for replacing lost or broken ticket media. It is USD 25.00 on the Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket, the Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket and the Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack, USD 20.00 on the Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack, and nil on the remaining two products.

**Which product is the exception on loading?** The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket alone does not take days onto media the guest already holds, its media being a paper ticket.

**Which ticket offices issue a product?** Those at the collective's mountains named in the last column. The Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack is issued at all five; the Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket at Granite Ridge only.
